title: Treasure Hunt
description:
ONAM ODYSSEY — “When Legends Unite!”
This Onam, step beyond the celebrations and enter a world of legends, mysteries, and adventure. Onam Odyssey is an exciting team-based treasure hunt designed exclusively for 1st-year students, combining the spirit of Onam with an adventurous campus-wide quest.

title: Culturals
description: Get ready to be spellbound! Experience a high-octane cultural showcase featuring electrifying dance performances, sensational solo singers, and powerhouse duos. Grab your spots and cheer for your friends as they set the stage on fire! 🔥🎶

title: Chendamelam
description:
Feel the rhythm before you even see the stage. 🥁🔥
Let the powerful beats, traditional melodies, and infectious energy fill the air as Chendamelam brings the festive spirit to life. Come be part of the crowd and experience the sound of celebration together!

title: Thiruvathira
description:
Grace, rhythm, tradition, and togetherness come alive on stage. 🌸✨
Watch the performers move in perfect harmony as the timeless beauty of Thiruvathira unfolds through music, movement, and Kerala's rich cultural spirit. A celebration of tradition you won't want to miss!

title: Tug of War
description:
One rope. Two teams. One goal. Zero backing down. ⚡💪
Bring your strongest squad and get ready for a battle of strength, teamwork, and determination. Every pull matters, every cheer counts, and the crowd decides just how intense it gets!

title: Sadhya
description:
A feast that needs no introduction. 💛🍃
From the first bite to the last, experience the flavours, aromas, and traditions that make an Onam Sadhya truly special. Gather around, enjoy the feast, and celebrate Onam the way it was meant to be celebrated!

title: Games
description:
Ready to put your skills, speed, and competitive spirit to the test? 👀🔥
Whether it's friendly rivalry or full-on competition, the games are all about having fun, making memories, and giving everyone something to cheer for. Bring your friends and let the games begin!

title: Kalari Payattu
description:
Power meets precision, and tradition meets action. ⚔️🔥
Witness the incredible speed, strength, agility, and discipline of Kerala's legendary martial art as every movement tells a story of centuries-old tradition. Get ready for a performance that demands your attention!

title: Aurora Dance
description:
Lights up. Music on. Energy unleashed. ✨🔥
Get ready for a vibrant performance filled with rhythm, movement, and electrifying energy. With every beat and every step, Aurora Dance is set to turn the stage into a celebration you won't want to take your eyes off!

title: Aalekh Pageant
description:
The spotlight is ready, and the stage belongs to them. 👑✨
Confidence, personality, style, and presence come together for an evening of unforgettable moments. Watch the contestants own the stage, bring their individuality forward, and make the Aalekh Pageant one of the highlights of the day!

title: DJ Night
description:
The day ends, but the celebration is only getting started. 🔥🎶
Turn up the volume and get ready for an evening packed with beats, lights, dancing, and unstoppable energy. Bring your crew, hit the floor, and make the final moments of Onam a night worth remembering! 💿⚡

title: Movie Night: Dhurandhar
description: Get ready for an unforgettable evening featuring DHURANDHAR — packed with action, drama, power and cinematic madness! 🔥🍿

title: Movie Night: Salaar
description:
🔥⚔️ When the screen lights up, the noise begins.

*Salaar* isn't just a movie night — it's an experience built for a packed auditorium. The thunderous music, larger-than-life action, intense moments, and that electric energy when the entire crowd erupts. 🖤💥

Bring your crew, bring the madness, and get ready to experience *Salaar* the way it deserves to be watched — LOUD, BIG, and together. 🎬🔥

One screen. One crowd. Pure adrenaline. ⚡

title: Movie Night: Gilli
description:
🎥💛 Haii Chellooom...

What's better than watching Ghilli?

Watching it with a packed auditorium full of friends, nostalgia, whistles, and unforgettable moments. 🔥

"Naa nerla varen da!" ⚡

title: Movie Night: Premam
description:
🎬🌸 For the ones who grew up with *Premam*…

Some stories become memories. Some songs take you straight back. And some movies just hit different when the whole auditorium is singing, laughing, cheering, and living every moment together. ❤️🔥

Get your friends together, bring the nostalgia, and experience *Premam* like never before — on the big screen, surrounded by a crowd that feels every scene just as much as you do. 🍿✨

One movie. A thousand memories. One unforgettable night. 🌙🎞️
